baseline.observed_behavior: files larger than MAX_FILE_BYTES are skipped before scan and are not represented as incomplete coverage
baseline.risk: a scan can return PASS while oversize files were not inspected

falsifier: create an oversize text file and require the scanner result to be INCOMPLETE with a nonzero exit status
closure_gate: scanner implementation must be committed on an isolated branch and repository tests must preserve all prior PASS while oversize coverage returns INCOMPLETE
